standard: docs/RECHECK-RUNNER.md with the 2.34 / 27 Sep grade standard as the 1.17.2 strategy review applied it: a grade moves one step at most, a move needs a kit or patch reason plus evidence the same way, a drop without a kit reason needs a 95% interval over at least 500 games to exclude the previous review rate with the games since review agreeing (the rule permits a drop; it does not require one), and a high rate alone never raises a grade. C is the lowest defined grade.

entries.reason: B retained, a judgment call. The engine withheld the grade for 'Statistics moved since review': the review cited 52.5% over 469 (17 Oct), and the Gold+ 1.17.2 carry line is now 49.4% over 1,618 [47.01, 51.88]. That interval excludes 52.5% with more than 500 games, and the games since the review (about 48.2% over 1,149) point the same way, so the drop rule permits B to C. It permits the drop; it does not require it, and the drop is not applied here: the interval still includes the carry role average (50.23% over 61,278), the engine's calculated tier is B, and three carries the review graded B sit lower over larger samples (Murdock 48.5% over 7,767, Skylar 47.1% over 3,284, Wraith 46.4% over 1,811), so a C would rank him below them. B ('situational or practiced pick') describes a near-average result. No official text changed since the review (both live articles match the packet's fingerprints; 1.17.2 lists no Grim.exe change). The watch text no longer says his results sit above the role average.
entries.limitation: The drop rule was available and not applied; the owner may prefer C. Bronze+ (nested, not independent) is lower, 48.0% over 3,846 [46.45, 49.60], and excludes the role average. Kira (A) is 49.3% over 4,679, so carry grades are not ordered by rate alone. No in-game test.

entries.reason: A to B under the drop rule. The 1.17.2 strategy review raised him B to A on the 1.17.2 Siphon, Colossal Blow and passive-stacking changes plus 52.6% over 308, and flagged that sample as its weakest raise (its interval reached below the role average). The Gold+ 1.17.2 jungle line is now 49.5% over 1,001 [46.36, 52.54], which excludes the 52.6% review rate with more than 500 games, and the games since the review (about 48.1% over 693) point the same way. No official text changed since the review (both live articles match the packet's fingerprints). The kit reason for the raise still holds and his results remain above his 1.17 line (44.0% over 571), but they now sit just under the jungle role average (50.50% over 62,080), the engine's calculated tier is B, and B junglers span 47.9% to 51.1% (Greystone 48.5% over 1,687, Kwang 48.6% over 3,230, Grux 50.2% over 3,222, Crunch 50.8% over 2,433). One step, as the rule allows. The watch text states the new grade and why.
entries.limitation: Close call: the interval's upper bound (52.54) clears the review rate (52.60) by only 0.06 points. Serath keeps A at 48.9% over 4,628, so A junglers are not ordered by rate alone. Bronze+ (nested, not independent) is lower, 46.7% over 1,763 [44.36, 49.02]. No in-game test.
